plugins.name: 1password-enconvo
plugins.description: Manage 1Password Environments from Enconvo: list, create and rename Environments, add variables, and mount on-demand .env files — with secrets never returned to the agent. Carries a full setup doctor and an agent skill teaching the never-read-a-mount policy. A thin curated client over 1Password's official Environments MCP server (1password-mcp); no server code bundled.
